name: Band Spanish Squat
cues: Loop a heavy band behind both knees and anchor it in front of you
Step back until the band is taut
Sit your hips back while your shins stay vertical
Lean back into the band and stand tall at the top

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Shins stay vertical (df 3 to 6, knee z moves 22 mm). Hips sit back 0.44 m to parallel (hip y 541 vs knee 533), knee 95, hip 113. The band stays taut from the knee loop to a knee-height anchor. COM is 155 mm behind the heels, which needs ~215 N of band pull at knee height, plausible for a heavy band. The trunk leans 29 deg forward, slightly more than 'lean back into the band' suggests, but acceptable.
